sync.title: GitHub
sync.description: Connect the project to a repository: every change in Messer creates a commit and every push to the branch creates a version in Messer.
sync.readOnly: Only an admin can connect, reconfigure or disconnect the repository.
sync.notConnected: The project is not connected to a repository.
sync.modeAppDescription: Short-lived tokens and a webhook managed by the app.
sync.modeAppUnavailable: Not configured in this Messer installation.
sync.modePatDescription: Fine-grained token with access to the repository.
sync.branchHint: Leave it empty to use the repository's default branch.
sync.tokenHint: Token permissions: Contents (read and write), Metadata (read) and, optionally, Webhooks (read and write) to create the webhook automatically. Stored encrypted.
sync.tokenKeep: Leave it empty to keep the stored token.
sync.connected: Repository connected. The first sync starts in a few seconds.
sync.disconnectDescription: Messer will stop pushing commits and receiving changes. The GitHub repository is not modified.
sync.head: Current commit in Messer
sync.conflicts: Conflicts resolved in favour of Messer in the last merge
sync.conflictsHint: GitHub's changes to those lines are kept in the repository history.
sync.webhookManualHint: Create a webhook in the repository's Settings → Webhooks with this URL, content type application/json, the «push» event and the secret shown when you connected.
sync.rotateDescription: The current secret will stop working: you will have to paste the new one in GitHub.
sync.secretDescription: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
sync.secretSteps: In GitHub: Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Payload URL: the webhook URL; Content type: application/json; Secret: this value; events: «Just the push event».

export.title: Export
export.description: Download the project as a self-contained .zip that starts with «docker compose up», with no dependency on Messer.
export.includeCode: The project code (agents, workflows and interfaces) at the chosen version
export.includeKnowledge: The linked knowledge bases as data (chunks and tables), with their policies applied
export.includeRuntime: The Messer engine, docker-compose.yml and a local platform service
export.includeDocs: A README with a quick start in Spanish and English
export.excludes: Secret values and connector credentials are not exported.
export.readOnly: You need the builder role or higher to export the project.
export.commitsError: The history could not be loaded; you can still export the latest version.
